title: Unpack the Gift Tags
statement: A shop prints short codes on gift tags to save space: `k[text]` means `text` repeated `k` times, and codes can sit inside each other. For example `2[ab3[c]]` unpacks to `abcccabccc`. Return the unpacked string for `code`.
constraints: code is valid; k is from 1 to 300
The unpacked string has at most 10^5 characters

answerKey.pattern: Stack of (text so far, repeat count) pairs, one per open bracket
keyPoints: Build the current text and the current number as you read
On '[', push the current text and the number, then start fresh
On ']', pop the pair: the new current text is the popped text plus the current text repeated the popped number of times
edgeCases: Numbers with two or three digits
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Recursion on each bracket group: same time, uses the call stack instead

hints: When you reach ']', what do you need to remember from before the matching '['?
At '[', save the text built so far and the repeat count on a stack, then start a new text.
At ']', pop them and combine: saved text + current text repeated count times.
